system.description:
Cloak of Shadows · cast at B-Rank · no type

+1d4 to Hide or Sneak attempts against creatures that rely on sight.

Cast in dim light or darkness: Identify Genjutsu checks against it are at disadvantage.

Concentration up to 10 minutes, with no chakra to maintain it.
